note: Independent semantic rejudgment 2026-11-12 against RFC 5176 Section 3 (the complete combination MUST match; otherwise NAK), current coa.go selectors and every tagged unit. Existing MatchedIdentificationSucceeds, UnmatchedIdentificationIsNAKed and NoSessionIdNotActedOn distinguish real CoA/Disconnect ACK/teardown from 503/no event/no teardown. ReplayReturnsCachedResponse now seeds the live accountant and still requires two ACKs but exactly one teardown. New RegisteredSubscriberAllSelectorsMustMatch sends an exact registry Acct-Session-Id plus conflicting User-Name or NAS-Port, requiring signed CoA-NAK 503 and unchanged installed rate. OldAccountingIdentityCannotSelectNewIncarnation and DisconnectOldAccountingIdentityCannotTerminateNewIncarnation keep the tuple/other selectors valid while changing only the full issued identity; they require signed 503, unchanged shaping and zero teardown. LiveAccountingOwnerIdentitySurvivesRegistryMiss supplies the actual current accountant ID alongside a different registry ID and requires signed ACK plus an installed 20M rate, preventing refusal of every fallback. Admission refuses unsupported identification types before matching; sessionSelectorsMatch intersects every occurrence of the three implemented selectors on both registry and complete-accountant fallback routes. Removing either intersection or restoring numeric-prefix matching makes exact outcome assertions fail. This judges the whole included-combination clause, not a claim to support the eleven refused types. Native proof freshness is a separate main-thread gate.
